text_block_list.text:
On the morning of the race, every<n>news outlet is
reporting on a single<n>topic.
Narita Brian Wins Derby, Closes in on<n>Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's the same story everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We can't let her steal all the thunder.<n>Well, I guess
I'll have my chance<n>soon enough.
Flash! Flash!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the Takarazuka Kinen<n>press
conference. Please raise your<n>hand if you'd like to
ask a question.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Yes! Over here, please!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Second row from the front, fourth seat<n>in. Go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm with the Daily Turf. Narita<n>Brian took
home her second crown<n>the other day. Can you tell
us how<n>you feel about your younger sister's<n>recent
successes?
Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
We'd like to ask you to please limit<n>your questions
to those concerning<n>the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. I can take this one. I was<n>expecting to
get this question.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is where the<n>best senior
Umamusume showcase<n>their skills. I want you all to
know that<n>I'll be taking home first.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm here not only to set the stage to<n>compete
against my sister—I'm here<n>to rise through the
ranks and become<n>the best of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Wait, can it be? So, she really plans<n>to...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will beat Narita Brian within the year.
Chatter, murmur...

Biwa Hayahide sets the press room<n>on fire with
that declaration.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I need you to change<n>tomorrow's headline!
Yeah, Hayahide<n>just dropped a bombshell!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Miss Hayahide! Would<n>you mind going
into more detail about<n>what you just said?

All eyes are on Biwa Hayahide as<n>she completely
steals the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I didn't expect the press conference<n>to run so late...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I'm glad I was able to say<n>everything I had to
say. All that's left<n>is for me to put everything out
there<n>at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Anything less than first<n>place isn't going
to cut it this time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do some light exercise to<n>round out the
night. Don't worry—I<n>won't overwork myself.

Biwa Hayahide dashes off, the very<n>picture of quiet
confidence. It's<n>amazing how strong she's
become.

There are still a few things left to do<n>before she can
take on the<n>Takarazuka Kinen in the best shape
possible.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Excuse me, do you happen to be<n>Biwa
Hayahide's trainer by any<n>chance?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is great! Do you have a<n>moment right
now? If you don't mind,<n>I'd love to interview—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, may I join in as well?<n>Perhaps we
could do a joint<n>interview!

Even though the press conference is<n>supposed to
be over, the reporters<n>bombard us with questions
well into<n>the night.

But they must've done their<n>research. They're
bound to have a<n>ton of information on the other
runners.
choice_data_list:
(This is a great opportunity to gather data for the
Takarazuka Kinen!)

text_block_list.text:
I turn on my computer to start putting<n>together Biwa
Hayahide's training<n>schedule.
Whirrr...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has taken the lead! Her<n>opponents may
be the finest racers<n>out there, but she's not giving
up her<n>spot, folks!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she's still pulling away! Look at<n>that
unbelievable speed! She's done<n>it! She's won the
Japanese Derby,<n>and she made it look easy!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Bri-an! Bri-an! Bri-an!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Listen to that crowd! Here she<n>is—Narita Brian, a
beast of a runner<n>and the greatest Umamusume of
all<n>time!

A video of Narita Brian's<n>performance at the
Japanese Derby<n>plays on my screen.

Her rate of improvement is<n>uncanny—scary even.
It's<n>unbelievable how she manages to<n>keep getting
better.
